cases.purpose: Verify device type, rdev, explicit and default modes under restrictive umask, existing-node preservation and invalid operands on both candidate and GNU reference.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils 9.7 mknod and explicit metadata assertions
cases.comparison: Each side must satisfy identical assertions and produce the same success marker and filesystem tree; failures require nonempty diagnostics without asserting diagnostic wording.
cases.script:
set -u
export LC_ALL=C
cu() { if [[ $(type -t coreutils) == builtin ]]; then coreutils "$@"; else "$@"; fi; }
fail() { echo "FAIL: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
reject() { local name=$1; shift; if cu mknod "$@" >out 2>err; then fail "$name accepted"; fi; [[ -s err ]] || fail "$name missing diagnostic"; }
umask 077
cu mknod -m 0640 cnode c 1 3 || fail char
cu mknod -m 0660 bnode b 7 200 || fail block
cu mknod clarge c 4095 1048575 || fail large-char
cu mknod -m 0444 blarge b 300 70000 || fail large-block
cu mknod -m 0640 fifo p || fail fifo
[[ $(umask) == 0077 ]] || fail 'umask changed'
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PYOBS' || exit 1
import os, stat
for path, kind, mode, maj, minor in [('cnode', stat.S_ISCHR, 0o640, 1, 3), ('bnode', stat.S_ISBLK, 0o660, 7, 200), ('clarge', stat.S_ISCHR, 0o600, 4095, 1048575), ('blarge', stat.S_ISBLK, 0o444, 300, 70000), ('fifo', stat.S_ISFIFO, 0o640, 0, 0)]:
    s = os.lstat(path)
    assert kind(s.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode) == mode, (path, s.st_mode)
    assert (os.major(s.st_rdev), os.minor(s.st_rdev)) == (maj, minor), path
PYOBS
reject exists cnode c 1 5
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PYOBS' || exit 1
import os, stat
s = os.lstat('cnode')
assert stat.S_ISCHR(s.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode) == 0o640 and (os.major(s.st_rdev), os.minor(s.st_rdev)) == (1, 3)
PYOBS
reject no-minor x1 c 1
reject no-numbers x2 b
reject fifo-numbers x3 p 1 2
reject bad-mode -m 999 x4 c 1 3
reject bad-type x5 q 1 2
reject extra-device x6 c 1 3 4
reject negative x7 c -1 3
reject overflow x8 c 4294967296 3
for f in x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6 x7 x8; do [[ ! -e $f && ! -L $f ]] || fail "unexpected $f"; done
/usr/bin/rm -f out err
echo 'mknod semantic checks passed'
